subject: extn
title: EXTN.------PART.
description: Chart on book p. 191 (EVOL-29). EXTN (existentialism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PART (participation) is the partner. From the subject: MO-DI and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From MO-DI: PROG-DY and IST-F-ACT. From DYM-F: RE-ST (restructuralism) and P-PROG (particular progressionalism). From RE-ST: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From P-PROG: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars).
